up: Find all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728695. Return the ChEMBL ID of each compound (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (if any), and its canonical SMILES (if available). Use the docs table to locate the document by its chembl_id, then join to compound_records via doc_id, and then to molecule_dictionary via molregno. Optionally join to compound_structures for SMILES. Do not add any extra filters such as activity data, document type, or year; only the document ChEMBL ID filter should be applied.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728695'
